ayahs.2: Bila-shubha is kitaab ka utaarna tamaam jahaanon ke Parwardigaar ki taraf se hai.
ayahs.3: Kya yeh kehte hain ke us ne ise ghad liya hai. (Nahin nahin) balke yeh tere Rabb Taala ki taraf se haq hai taake aap unhein daraayen jin ke paas aap se pehle koi daraane wala nahin aaya. Taake woh raah-e-raast par aa jaayen.
ayahs.4: Allah Taala woh hai jis ne aasman-o-zameen ko aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyaan hai sab ko chhe din mein paida kar diya phir Arsh par qaem hua, tumhare liye us ke siwa koi madadgaar aur sifarishi nahin. Kya phir bhi tum naseehat haasil nahin karte.
ayahs.5: Woh aasman se le kar zameen tak (har) kaam ki tadbeer karta hai. Phir (woh kaam) ek aise din mein us ki taraf chadh jaata hai jis ka andaaza tumhari ginti ke ek hazaar saal ke baraabar hai.
ayahs.6: Yehi hai chhupe khule ka jaanne wala, zabardast ghaalib bahut hi mehrbaan.
ayahs.7: Jis ne nihayat khoob banaai jo cheez bhi banaai aur insan ki banaawat mitti se shuru ki.
ayahs.8: Phir us ki nasal ek be-waqar paani ke nichod se chalaai.
ayahs.9: Jise theek thaak kar ke us mein apni rooh phoonki, isi ne tumhare kaan aankhen aur dil banaaye (is par bhi) tum bahut hi thoda ehsaan maante ho.
ayahs.10: Unhon ne kaha kya jab hum zameen mein mil jaayenge kya phir nai paidaish mein aa jaayenge? Balke (baat yeh hai) ke woh log apne Parwardigaar ki mulaaqaat ke munkir hain.
ayahs.11: Keh dijiye! Ke tumhein maut ka farishta faut karega jo tum par muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Phir tum sab apne Parwardigaar ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.12: Kaash ke aap dekhte jabke gunahgaar log apne Rabb Taala ke saamne sar jhukaaye hue honge, kahenge ae hamare Rabb! Hum ne dekh liya aur sun liya ab to hamein waapas lauta de hum nek aamaal karenge hum yaqeen karne wale hain.
ayahs.13: Agar hum chaahte to har shakhs ko hidayat naseeb farma dete, lekin meri yeh baat bilkul haq ho chuki hai ke main zaroor zaroor jahannam ko insanon aur jinnon se bhar doonga.
ayahs.14: Ab tum apne is din ki mulaaqaat ke faraamosh kar dene ka maza chakho, hum ne bhi tumhein bhula diya aur apne kiye hue aamaal (ki shaamat) se abadi azaab ka maza chakho.
ayahs.15: Hamari aayaton par wahi imaan laate hain jinhein jab kabhi un se naseehat ki jaati hai to woh sajde mein gir padte hain aur apne Rabb ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh padhte hain aur takabbur nahin karte hain.
ayahs.16: Un ki karwatein apne bistaron se alag rehti hain apne Rabb ko khauf aur umeed ke saath pukaarte hain aur jo kuchh hum ne unhein de rakha hai woh kharch karte hain.
ayahs.17: Koi nafs nahin jaanta jo kuchh hum ne un ki aankhon ki thandak un ke liye posheeda kar rakhi hai, jo kuchh karte the yeh us ka badla hai.
ayahs.18: Kya woh jo momin ho misl us ke hai jo faasiq ho? Yeh baraabar nahin ho sakte.
ayahs.19: Jin logon ne imaan qubool kiya aur nek aamaal bhi kiye un ke liye hameshgi wali jannatein hain, mehmandari hai un ke aamaal ke badle jo woh karte the.
ayahs.20: Lekin jin logon ne hukm-udooli ki un ka thikana dozakh hai. Jab kabhi is se baahar nikalna chaahenge isi mein lauta diye jaayenge. Aur keh diya jaayega ke apne jhutlaane ke badle aag ka azaab chakho.
ayahs.21: Bilyaqeen hum unhein qareeb ke chhote se baaz azaab is bade azaab ke siwa chakhaayenge taake woh laut aayen.
ayahs.22: Is se badh kar zaalim kaun hai jise Allah Taala ki aayaton se waaz kiya gaya phir bhi us ne un se munh pher liya, (yaqeen maano) ke hum bhi gunahgaaron se intiqaam lene wale hain.
ayahs.23: Beshak hum ne Moosa ko kitaab di, pas aap ko hargiz us ki mulaaqaat mein shak na karna chaahiye aur hum ne ise Bani Israeel ki hidayat ka zariya banaaya.
ayahs.24: Aur jab in logon ne sabr kiya to hum ne un mein se aise peshwa banaaye jo hamare hukm se logon ko hidayat karte the, aur woh hamari aayaton par yaqeen rakhte the.
ayahs.25: Aap ka Rabb in (sab) ke darmiyaan in (tamaam) baaton ka faisla qayamat ke din karega jin mein woh ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain.
ayahs.26: Kya is baat ne bhi unhein hidayat nahin di ke hum ne un se pehle bahut si ummaton ko halaak kar diya jin ke makaanon mein yeh chal phir rahe hain. Is mein to (badi) badi nishaaniyan hain. Kya phir bhi yeh nahin sunte?
ayahs.27: Kya yeh nahin dekhte ke hum paani ko banjar (ghair aabaad) zameen ki taraf baha kar le jaate hain phir is se hum khetiyan nikaalte hain jise un ke chaupaye aur yeh khud khaate hain, kya phir bhi yeh nahin dekhte?
ayahs.28: Aur kehte hain ke yeh faisla kab hoga? Agar tum sachche ho (to batlaao).
ayahs.29: Jawab de do ke faisle wale din imaan laana be-imaanon ko kuchh kaam na aayega aur na unhein dheel di jaayegi.
ayahs.30: Ab aap un ka khayaal chhod dein aur muntazir rahen. Yeh bhi muntazir hain.
